title: CXMT allegedly follows 'Project Haf' plan to capture global memory market
summary: Chinese chipmaker CXMT is alleged to be following a plan named 'Project Haf' to capture the global DRAM market, involving steps such as stealing Samsung's technology documentation and recruiting employees. The plan is compared to schemes from Dr. Evil movies. CXMT currently holds 10% of the market.
